components.name: Pedal Stompbox Card
components.description: The signature component: a diecast pedal enclosure with corner screws, silkscreen ID plate, knurled knobs, chrome footswitch + jewel LED, and a side jack nub.
components.html: Distortion
components.css: .ds-stompbox{--pedal-color:oklch(66% 0.19 45);position:relative;width:160px;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;color:oklch(97% 0.01 90);background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 40% at 50% 6%,rgba(255,255,255,.28) 0%,transparent 60%),linear-gradient(175deg,color-mix(in oklch,var(--pedal-color) 68%,#3a3d43 32%) 0%,color-mix(in oklch,var(--pedal-color) 46%,#17191d 54%) 58%,color-mix(in oklch,var(--pedal-color) 30%,#0a0b0d 70%) 100%);border:1.5px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--pedal-color) 32%,black 68%);box-shadow:0 20px 30px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 6px 12px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.55)} .ds-screw{position:absolute;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 44%,rgba(0,0,0,.6) 44% 56%,transparent 56%),linear-gradient(to right,transparent 44%,rgba(0,0,0,.6) 44% 56%,transparent 56%),radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#dfe1e4,#8a8e95 55%,#4c4f55 100%)} .ds-jack{position:absolute;right:-4px;top:64%;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#eef0f2,#8a8e95 55%,#35373b 100%);border:2px solid #1c1d1f} .ds-plate{width:100%;padding-bottom:7px;margin-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.3)} .ds-label{font-family:Anton,"Arial Narrow",sans-serif;font-size:15px;text-transform:uppercase;color:oklch(98% 0.01 90);text-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)} .ds-footswitch{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg,#d6d9dc 0deg 4deg,#9a9ea5 4deg 8deg);border:3px solid #17181a;box-shadow:0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.65),inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.5);position:relative;margin-top:14px} .ds-led{position:absolute;top:-13px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--pedal-color) 85%,white 15%);box-shadow:0 0 8px 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--pedal-color) 90%,transparent)}

components.name: Enable Audio Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action, styled as a lit pilot-light footswitch button.
components.css: .ds-enable-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:Anton,"Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;font-size:13px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(180deg,oklch(80% 0.15 145) 0%,oklch(62% 0.14 150) 100%);color:oklch(16% 0.03 150);border:1px solid oklch(40% 0.1 150);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset,0 3px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)} .ds-enable-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)} .ds-enable-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(72% 0.17 145);outline-offset:2px} .ds-enable-led{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:oklch(30% 0.04 150);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}

components.name: Mini Toggle
components.description: Pill-shaped rocker-style toggle for Noise Gate / Denoise / Acoustic Sim controls — the system's one deliberate pill form.
components.css: .ds-mini-toggle{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:36px;height:19px} .ds-mini-toggle input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer} .ds-mini-toggle label{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;background:oklch(20% 0.01 260);border:1px solid oklch(9% 0.01 260);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6);transition:background .15s} .ds-mini-toggle label::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4f4f4,#c7c7c7);top:1px;left:1px;transition:left .15s;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)} .ds-mini-toggle input:checked+label{background:linear-gradient(180deg,oklch(70% 0.17 145),oklch(50% 0.15 145))} .ds-mini-toggle input:checked+label::after{left:18px} .ds-mini-toggle input:focus-visible+label{outline:2px solid oklch(75% 0.11 85);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: The Rack, Not the Icon Set
narrative.overview: The app is a real pedalboard: diecast stompbox enclosures with phillips screws, a silkscreen ID plate, knurled pots, a chrome footswitch with a jewel LED, and a side jack — racked onto a felt-lined pedalboard rail under a dark rack-strip topbar. This is the second visual identity this app has shipped. The first was a photoreal-skeuomorphic stompbox skin; a second attempt replaced it with a kraft-cardboard retail-box register that the user rejected outright for reading as stationery, not music gear. This build is a from-scratch rebuild grounded in reference photography of real Boss/Ibanez/Electro-Harmonix pedals and a Pedaltrain board, refusing both the earlier chrome-photoreal extreme and the paper-flat retreat.
keyCharacteristics: Literal diecast pedal enclosures with 4 corner phillips screws, a side jack, and a silkscreen ID plate.
Knurled black-plastic knobs with a printed tick-mark reference arc.
A chrome-ribbed footswitch with a jewel LED that only glows when engaged.
A felt-and-cable-groove pedalboard rail, not a generic dark card grid.
Amps render in a distinct brushed-aluminum finish, a different hardware class from stompboxes.
Anton for every wordmark/headline, system sans for body copy, monospace for live readings.

rules.name: The One-Color-Per-Category Rule
rules.body: Each pedal/amp type owns exactly one flat paint color (--pedal-color), applied to its enclosure gradient, knob-pointer accent, and footswitch LED consistently.

rules.name: The Metal-Stays-Metal Rule
rules.body: Screws, the jack barrel, and the footswitch face always render in the chrome ramp regardless of the enclosure's paint color.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any numeral read as a live measurement renders in monospace with tabular figures; Anton never carries a numeral.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional label drops below 11px, even in the densest toolbar control strip.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Glowing Rule
rules.body: The only colored, blurred glow in the system is a genuine LED indicator; no other element borrows that treatment as decoration.

dos: Do keep every enclosure gradient standing in for real paint sheen, never a flat single-color fill.
Do render screws, the jack, and the footswitch face in the metal ramp regardless of --pedal-color.
Do keep the jewel-LED glow as the system's only decorative blur.
Do keep functional text at 11px or larger.
Do pair any machined 1.5-2px border with a tightened shadow, never a hairline border with a large diffuse blur.
donts: Don't reintroduce kraft/paper/cardboard color, barcode corners, or rubber-stamp print flourishes anywhere.
Don't flatten a pedal enclosure to a single solid-fill icon swatch.
Don't use a colored border-left strip as a category-color legend; use a small swatch dot instead.
Don't add a second pill-shaped control beyond the mini-toggle.
